item.title: Keichan: Gifu's Miso-Marinated Grilled Chicken — Guide
item.description: Keichan is a hearty local dish from the Gujo and Hida areas of Gifu, consisting of chicken marinated in a savoury sauce, usually miso-based but sometimes soy or salt, then grilled together with cabbage and other vegetables on a hot plate, frequently cooked at the table. Originally a home-style farmhouse dish, its bold, garlicky-miso flavour and satisfying, communal cooking style have made it a beloved regional comfort food, served at restaurants and sold as marinated packs to cook at home.
